name: Restaurant Opening
purpose: Provide a consistent, controlled method for restaurant opening so the restaurant can operate safely, consistently and with clear accountability.
steps: Complete access/opening security checks.
Inspect premises for hazards, cleanliness, pests, damage, utilities and equipment readiness.
Start required systems/equipment using their approved procedures.
Verify kitchen, storage, front-of-house, washroom and staff areas are ready.
Review staffing, reservations, stock, special events and outstanding safety/corrective issues.
Complete the opening checklist and escalate anything preventing safe operation.

name: Restaurant Closing
purpose: Provide a consistent, controlled method for restaurant closing so the restaurant can operate safely, consistently and with clear accountability.
steps: Confirm service, customer orders, payments and handovers are complete.
Secure food, ingredients, records, cash and equipment.
Clean/sanitize required areas and remove waste.
Check storage/refrigeration conditions and record required readings.
Shut down equipment/utilities approved for shutdown while leaving required safety systems active.
Complete closing records, handover unresolved issues and secure the premises.

name: Shift Handover
purpose: Provide a consistent, controlled method for shift handover so the restaurant can operate safely, consistently and with clear accountability.
steps: Review the operational requirement and confirm the responsible person and available resources.
Inspect the relevant area, information and equipment before starting.
Perform the activity in the approved sequence and current restaurant standard.
Verify completion against defined acceptance criteria.
Record the required result, exception or handover information.
Escalate deviations and complete corrective action where required.

name: Food Safety Management
purpose: Provide a consistent, controlled method for food safety management so the restaurant can operate safely, consistently and with clear accountability.
steps: Confirm the work area, equipment and food-contact surfaces are clean and ready.
Verify product identity, condition, label/date and required temperature or traceability information.
Perform the task using clean hands, suitable protective clothing and clean/dedicated utensils.
Follow the approved recipe, specification or validated control limit; do not improvise a safety-critical limit.
Check the result before release to storage, preparation, service or disposal.
Record required observations or measurements and report deviations immediately.
controls: Prevent contamination and maintain hygienic practices throughout the process.

Inspect packaging, condition, dates and acceptance criteria before accepting or moving stock.
